$comment: The complete chorus.yml v1 format contract. See ARCHITECTURE.md section 3.9. TODO: ZSTD/GZIP compression and REGISTRY/REDIS replay backends are reserved and rejected by runtime assembly until implemented.
title: Chorus configuration v1
description: Static Core configuration with explicit operational limits. Assembly checks duration arithmetic, field relationships, implemented options, key contents, and directory references.

role.description: GATEWAY sends tickets, BACKEND receives tickets, and PEER supports both operations.

cookie-key.description: The namespaced Minecraft Cookie key shared by sender and receiver.

max-payload-bytes.description: Maximum complete encoded ticket payload, including JWS framing and signature.

max-property-bytes.description: UTF-8 profile property budget. Must not exceed max-payload-bytes.

compression.$comment: TODO: Implement ZSTD and GZIP with versioned framing and bounded decompression. Only NONE is operational; CoreBootstrap rejects the reserved choices.

private-key.description: PKCS#8 Ed25519 private key path relative to chorus.yml. Required for sender.

public-key.description: Matching X.509 SPKI public key path relative to chorus.yml. Required for sender.

servers-path.description: Directory path relative to chorus.yml, validated with servers.schema.json.

issuers-path.description: Trust path relative to chorus.yml, validated with trusted-issuers.schema.json.

issuance.description: Sender permissions and lifetime. Receivers independently enforce their trust policies.

ttl.description: Positive whole-second lifetime, no greater than verification.max-lifetime.

max-lifetime.description: Positive maximum accepted lifetime in whole seconds. Must cover issuance.ttl when sending.

clock-skew.description: Nonnegative whole-second allowance bound to the replay database.

backend.$comment: TODO: Implement REGISTRY using the registry database and implement REDIS. Only LOCAL is operational. REGISTRY is invalid with registry.provider STATIC.

path.description: Persistent SQLite path relative to chorus.yml. Preserve the database and WAL.

busy-timeout.description: Positive lock wait whose whole milliseconds fit 1..2147483647.

redis.$comment: TODO: Define Redis settings together with the Redis ReplayGuard implementation. This empty placeholder does not enable that backend.

allOf.$comment: Registry replay cannot use a static file provider.

duration.description: An unsigned integer followed by ms, s, m, or h, or the Java Duration ISO-8601 syntax. Range and normalized sign are checked during conversion.

wholeSecondDuration.description: Whole-second precision, including exact multiples of 1000ms and ISO fractions containing only zeroes.
